other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must belong to a tribal community (Scheduled Tribe)
Applicant must have passed class 12th from a government or non‑government college
Applicant must be enrolled in a graduate, graduate diploma, technical or paramedical course
Applicant must be regularly admitted in the course they are pursuing
Applicant must not have received admission to a government hostel
Applicant must be pursuing higher education outside their hometown where hostels are not available
benefits_summary: Provides housing assistance to tribal boys and girls to continue higher education outside their hometown when hostel accommodation is unavailable.
